mutations.name: AG-DOCDATA
mutations._mechanism: Removing the doc/data bypass judges a listed README with an absent test.

mutations.name: AG-NOT-CODE-LIKE
mutations._mechanism: A test-shaped Python file must not fall into the non-Python listing path.
mutations.find: if any(Path(identity.fold_py_suffix(n)).suffix == ".py" for n in resolved.names):  # M:AG-NOT-CODE-LIKE

mutations.name: AG-LIST-EXEMPT
mutations._mechanism: Removing the location bypass judges an exempt listed target.

mutations.name: AG-CHAIN-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Unreadable governing state must deny before the inactive-chain branch.

mutations.name: AG-LIST-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Unreadable plans must take the listing-specific judge-error denial.

mutations.name: AG-VERDICT
mutations._mechanism: Ignoring the judge verdict admits a listed target whose test is absent.

mutations.name: AG-NOT-LISTED
mutations._mechanism: Unlisted targets must skip the judge instead of passing it None.

mutations.name: AG-ACTIVE
mutations._mechanism: Forcing the inactive branch bypasses active listed targets; False would be equivalent.
